title: Inherited client app, no handover, no documentation
notes: The directory listing contains two findings visible before any code is read, and a good answer spots at least the first. (1) Both yarn.lock and package-lock.json are present — two package managers, so installs are non-deterministic and whichever the previous agency actually used is unknown. This must be resolved before anything else, because every subsequent step depends on a reproducible install. (2) patches/ exists, which is a list of things that hurt someone enough to fork a dependency in place, and is the highest-information directory for an inheritor. Beyond those, the correct approach is to read decisions before code — package.json, native config, New Arch status, git history — rather than starting at App.tsx and following imports. Should also flag that the README is unverified and that the test suite must be run rather than assumed. Tests whether the agent reads the evidence it was given rather than producing a generic onboarding checklist.
